question: Does the exact pooled projector that passed reverse OOD also preserve the original forward rank48 OOD source-to-reader program?

authority.pooled_fit_implementation: The shared helper exactly factors the v2 pooled fit: all v13/v12 target rows, both matched-control splits, and all old rank-64 MLP input-training rows. Its projector hashes must reproduce the reverse receipt.

evaluation: Forward base-to-donor rank48 source execution on row-disjoint temporal-v12/iswas-v11 OOD targets and temporal-v12 P controls, using the frozen pooled projector at gain 1.0.

predictions.pred_a_authority_projector_replay_disjoi: Authorities match, all eight pooled projector hashes reproduce the reverse receipt, fit/evaluation IDs are disjoint, values are finite, and exactly 16 forwards execute.
predictions.pred_b_pooled_forward_coordinates_transf: Every coordinate projection is at least 0.75 and mean/worst coordinate residual are each at most 0.20.
predictions.pred_c_pooled_forward_behavior_transfers: Temporal and is/was behavior projections are each at least 0.80 and worst target residual is at most 0.15.
predictions.pred_d_pooled_forward_controls_are_selec: Control margin RMS is at most 0.10, median full-vocabulary KL at most 0.02, and top-one flip fraction is at most 0.05.
predictions.pred_e_one_pooled_interface_is_bidirecti: The reverse authority remains 5/5 and the pooled forward arm passes B-D, establishing the same projector/support in both directions.

decision: All five predictions establish one complete-family pooled rank48 response interface with bidirectional OOD manipulation. Failure preserves the pooled reverse screen but rejects a unified bidirectional projector.
